urdu: باڑہ ثقافت کے ابتدائی شواہد کہاں سے دریافت ہوئے تھے؟
english: Where were the initial evidences of the Bara culture discovered?
roman_1: Bara saqafat kay ibtedai shawaahid kahan se daryaft hue thay?
roman_2: Bara saqafat ke ibtedai shawaid kahan se daryaft hue the?
roman_3: Bara sakafat k ibtedai shawaid kahan se daryaft hue they?
